children: The Uniswap price has a rather interesting backdrop right now. Uniswap on Robinhood Chain has reached an all-time high in stock-token trading volume, processing roughly $130 million in daily transactions, nearly ten times more than a month ago. That’s a sharp jump for an on-chain market increasingly tied to traditional financial assets.
Robinhood Chain Activity Is Accelerating Fast

The volume is also being split almost evenly between Uniswap v3 and v4. While v3 continues to provide deep concentrated liquidity pools, v4 is gaining ground through custom hooks, dynamic routing and lower transaction costs. The bigger point is pretty simple: upgraded DEX infrastructure is now handling substantial equity-trading activity.
And that gives the Uniswap price story a little more substance than another routine token rally.
UNI Price Has Already Risen Over 90%
UNI price has climbed from around $2.40 in June to roughly $4.60 in August, a gain of more than 90%. But the chart gets more interesting when viewed through its earlier price behavior.

The late-2020 liquidation-grab move was followed by a parabolic run toward the $44 all-time high. A similar liquidity-grab characteristic is now being observed in the 2026 UNI price action, although whether history repeats is obviously another question.

If follow-up demand arrives in UNI token price, then $7.82 becomes the first major hurdle because it aligns with the weekly 200-EMA. A successful breakout could put $11 and eventually $22 on the radar.
HOOD Stock Adds Another Piece To Setup
Robinhood’s own stock provides another interesting comparison. HOOD previously saw a cup-and-handle pattern push it toward an all-time high near $154.

After falling roughly 58% to $64 in 2026, the stock reversed from April and has since followed an ascending trendline. If that support remains intact, another move toward $154 and potentially price discovery phase could also emerge.
For now, the Uniswap price has improving activity behind it, but $7.82 remains the level bulls need to conquer before the bigger targets become relevant.

title: Uniswap Price Eyes Bigger Rally As Robinhood Activity Surges
